# Shoppers save items for later

## Description

A signed-in shopper saves an item from the cart and finds it on the next visit. It delivers the initiative's saved-items requirement.

## Outcome

Shoppers come back to what they saved; the BRD's week-later check is the signal.

## Requirements

- R1 (parent R4): A signed-in shopper saves an item from the cart and finds it in saved items on the next visit.

## Constraints

- A saved item shows its current price (RULE-4).

## Done when

1. Saved items survive sign-out and come back on the live site.

## Boundaries

Saved items only. Not the cart lines (epic-checkout).

## References

- parent — _bmad-output/initiative-cart/initiative-cart.md, section Requirements

## Notes

- Dropped: the sponsor cut saved items from the first release to launch sooner (2026-10-20).
